children: This is the gallery subpage for the Riot Guard. It contains images of every skin, descriptions, skin information and more.

Tan skin, grey hair, grey shirt, brown pants, shoes, knee-pads and vest, black belt and a grey helmet.

Wields a small grey shield.
'"`UNIQ--nowiki-00000000-QINU`"'

Fully body armor that consists of a grey vest with pockets, shoulder-pads, knee-pads, riot helmet with a visor, mask, shoes and gloves.

Shirt and pants are now grey.

Now wields a grey ballistic shield with an orange window.

Tan skin, dark green shirt and pants, brown helmet, vest, knee-pads, thigh-pads and shoulder-pads.

Carries a brown shield.
'"`UNIQ--nowiki-00000001-QINU`"'

Grey elbow-pads and black and white cape.

Mask now has a black visor instead of a brown one.

Vest is now improved with a yellow outline on its collar.

Shoulder-pads and thigh-pads are now white with yellow outlines.

Now carries a bigger brown and black shield.

Blue skin, dark blue and blue wings, blue spikes on the head, dark blue vest, blue ice around shoulders and feet.

Carries a blue shield.
'"`UNIQ--nowiki-00000002-QINU`"'

Dark blue and blue galea helmet and dark blue arms with visible fingers.

Now has white snow on its shield.

Black skin, neon green eyes, grey and green armor, shoes and helmet, grey bones coming out of its armor.

Carries a grey and brown shield to attack enemies.
'"`UNIQ--nowiki-00000003-QINU`"'
Armor, shoes, helmet and shield are now grey and purple, bones are now purple and eyes are now neon purple.
